infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DO NOTHIN. uses the camera with on-device face detection to verify you stay present and track stillness during focus sessions. No face data is stored or shared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: DO NOTHIN. needs microphone access to record verification videos during focus sessions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DO NOTHIN. needs photo library access to save your session videos and share cards.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DO NOTHIN. needs permission to save your session verification videos and selfie share cards to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSFamilyControlsUsageDescription: DO NOTHIN. uses Screen Time to help you manage which apps you want to pause before opening, giving you a moment to focus.
